scope: Hand-fit report for the Sculpted tip and display cover from the Mark One wing receiver clearance trial. Derek also tried an earlier cover on the same tip.

observations.cover_lift: Derek felt the cover pushing upward off the curved tip and attributed it to pressure from its clamping wings. The blades engage the receiver ledges to hold the cover down.
observations.blade_insertion: Derek could squeeze the middle of a wing farther into the receiver. He reported that the plain lateral ends of the wing bear on the adjacent tip stock and hold the blade out of the channel.
observations.receiver_clearance: Derek reported excess clearance in Z at the blade receiver.
observations.cover_arch: The front and rear of the paired cover appeared to have excess arch relief. With an earlier cover on the same tip, Derek reported that the arch gap closed and the wing still needed pressure to seat.

requested_fit_changes.reference_frame: The axes follow the display face, with positive Z pointing out of the face.
requested_fit_changes.receiver: Keep the added Y clearance, deepen the blade channels in X, restore the Z clearance at the retaining ledge, and relieve the stock where the plain wing ends bear.
requested_fit_changes.cover: Reduce the arch relief at the front and rear.
